skills.name: find-skill
skills.description: Search and evaluate the best 2-5 skills/commands to run for a given user prompt. Runs export_for_jev.py to scrape live .agents/skills and .claude/commands descriptions, produces a ranked multi-agent recommendation, and outputs a jev-ready verification block for external AI to confirm or correct the selection. Use when asked to find the right agent, search for a skill, route a task, or when the user prompt is ambiguous.

commands.name: /find-skill-opt
commands.description: Cost-optimized skill finder using pre-computed database (95% token savings)

commands.name: /find-skill
commands.description: Finds the best 2-5 skills/commands/rules for your task and outputs a single copy-pasteable prompt block. NEVER reads skill files. NEVER executes the task. NEVER analyzes attached files or context. For 95% token savings, use /find-skill-opt.
